consequence.statement: The write dedupe cache is deprecated; the evidence says it is not required by tsdb and boltdb-shipper indexes. It is not stated to fail today.

original.statement: Loki's write dedupe cache is deprecated because the newer single store indexes (tsdb and boltdb-shipper) do not require it.

decision.reason: [ev-4e830661fba0] says only that Loki 3.0.0 deprecates the write dedupe cache because tsdb and boltdb-shipper don't need it. It doesn't say anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. So the right kind is deprecation (review), not a failure kind. The proposed statement and low severity stay within what the evidence says.
